note: Phase 6E — fused decode-write CUDA kernels. Replaces the writer's per-decode-step Python op chain (~30 small CUDA kernel launches per layer per step) with two fused custom CUDA kernels (fused_decode_write_v + fused_decode_write_k) under the PHASE6E_FUSED_WRITER=1 env flag. Default is OFF; FUSED=0 retains the original inline op chain bit-for-bit. Byte equivalence verified by verify_phase6e_fused_byte_eq.py (15 tests across B=1..32, multi-block boundaries, inactive masks, non-contiguous QKV view). Only phase5b_4c_paged_writer.py changed in the existing 10-file set; new CUDA package at CTM_plus/CUDA_int4_protected/ is additive.
